sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.extract: Medical imaging provides a mechanism to study in vivo physiological properties of the human body, and thus plays an important role in the diagnosis, prognosis, and assessment of treatment response of diﬀerent diseases. sections.extract: We evaluated the performance of the NGSE technique using multiple numerical experiments. In each experiment, P = 200 true values were sampled from a known FPBD. sections.title: Discussion and Conclusion
sections.extract: For clinical translation of QI, there is an important need for techniques that can objectively evaluate QI methods with patient data. In this context, existing statistical techniques assume that the noise between measurements obtained using diﬀerent methods is independent of each other.
